definition_en: to make something bad less severe
example_en: New sea walls were built to [mitigate] the damage caused by floods.
example_zh: 新建的海堤用来减轻洪水造成的损失。

definition_en: large in amount or value
example_en: The company made a [substantial] profit from its new product.
example_zh: 公司从新产品中获得了可观的利润。

definition_en: common or widespread at a particular time
example_en: Smartphone addiction is increasingly [prevalent] among teenagers.
example_zh: 手机成瘾在青少年中越来越普遍。

definition_en: including all or nearly all aspects
example_en: The report gives a [comprehensive] review of recent research on sleep.
example_zh: 这份报告对近期的睡眠研究做了全面的综述。

definition_en: able to continue without harming the environment
example_en: The city is investing in [sustainable] public transport.
example_zh: 这座城市正在投资可持续的公共交通。

definition_en: a typical model or way of thinking
example_en: Einstein's work created a new [paradigm] for thinking about space and time.
example_zh: 爱因斯坦的研究开创了思考时空的新范式。

definition_en: to limit what someone can do
example_en: Lack of funding may [constrain] the growth of small firms.
example_zh: 资金不足可能限制小企业的发展。

definition_en: a large and often unfair difference
example_en: There is a growing [disparity] between urban and rural incomes.
example_zh: 城乡收入差距日益扩大。

definition_en: to publicly support an idea or policy
example_en: Many doctors [advocate] regular exercise for older people.
example_zh: 许多医生提倡老年人经常锻炼。

definition_en: a person who publicly supports a cause
example_en: She has long been an [advocate] of women's rights.
example_zh: 她长期以来一直是女性权益的倡导者。

definition_zh: 实证的；以经验为依据的
definition_en: based on observation or experiment
example_en: The theory still lacks [empirical] evidence.
example_zh: 这一理论仍然缺乏实证依据。

definition_en: existing in large quantities
example_en: The region has [abundant] rainfall in summer.
example_zh: 该地区夏季雨量充沛。

definition_en: to make pain or a problem easier to bear
example_en: The medicine helped [alleviate] her back pain.
example_zh: 这种药帮助缓解了她的背痛。

definition_en: a young person between child and adult
example_en: Every [adolescent] goes through big physical changes during puberty.
example_zh: 每个青少年在青春期都会经历巨大的身体变化。

definition_en: a strong wish to achieve something
example_en: Her [ambition] is to become a surgeon.
example_zh: 她的抱负是成为一名外科医生。

definition_en: to make small changes to a law or document
example_en: Parliament voted to [amend] the tax law.
example_zh: 议会投票决定修订税法。

definition_en: with a name that is not known
example_en: The museum received a gift from an [anonymous] donor.
example_zh: 博物馆收到一位匿名捐赠者的礼物。

definition_en: based on chance or personal wish rather than reason
example_en: The manager made an [arbitrary] decision without giving any reason.
example_zh: 经理没给任何理由就做了一个武断的决定。

definition_en: to help something increase or improve
example_en: The festival is expected to [boost] hotel bookings by twenty percent.
example_zh: 这个节日预计将使酒店预订量提高百分之二十。

definition_en: a system with too many complicated official rules
example_en: Getting a simple permit takes months because of [bureaucracy].
example_zh: 由于官僚作风，办一张简单的许可证都要几个月。

definition_en: careful to avoid risks
example_en: Investors are [cautious] and prefer to keep their money in the bank.
example_zh: 投资者很谨慎，宁愿把钱存在银行。

definition_en: to love and protect something important
example_en: We should [cherish] the time we spend with our parents.
example_zh: 我们应该珍惜与父母相处的时光。

definition_en: moving or doing things in an awkward way
example_en: The [clumsy] waiter dropped a tray of glasses.
example_zh: 笨手笨脚的服务员摔了一托盘杯子。

definition_en: to fall down or fail suddenly
example_en: The old bridge could [collapse] at any moment.
example_zh: 那座旧桥随时可能倒塌。

definition_en: a product that can be bought and sold
example_en: Oil is the most traded [commodity] in the world.
example_zh: 石油是世界上交易量最大的大宗商品。

definition_en: able to work or exist together
example_en: This charger is [compatible] with most phones.
example_zh: 这个充电器与大多数手机兼容。

definition_en: to pay or give something for a loss
example_en: The airline agreed to [compensate] passengers for the delay.
example_zh: 航空公司同意就延误向乘客赔偿。

definition_en: to follow rules or accepted standards
example_en: All products must [conform] to safety standards.
example_zh: 所有产品都必须符合安全标准。

definition_en: a feeling that someone is worthless
example_en: She looked at the cheater with [contempt].
example_zh: 她轻蔑地看着那个作弊者。

definition_en: to grow plants or crops
example_en: Farmers here [cultivate] rice on terraced fields.
example_zh: 这里的农民在梯田上种植水稻。

definition_en: to develop a skill, habit or relationship
example_en: Reading every day helps children [cultivate] good habits.
example_zh: 每天阅读有助于孩子培养良好习惯。

definition_en: to give time or effort to something
example_en: She decided to [devote] her life to medical research.
example_zh: 她决定把一生献给医学研究。

definition_en: a situation that needs a difficult choice
example_en: Choosing between two good job offers was a real [dilemma].
example_zh: 在两个不错的工作机会之间做选择真是两难。

definition_en: detailed and carefully planned
example_en: The chef spent three days preparing [elaborate] decorations for the cake.
example_zh: 厨师花了三天为蛋糕准备精美的装饰。

definition_en: to slowly damage or reduce something
example_en: Strong waves continue to [erode] the coastline.
example_zh: 强浪不断侵蚀海岸线。

definition_en: to use someone unfairly for your own advantage
example_en: Some factories [exploit] workers by paying them very little.
example_zh: 一些工厂以极低工资剥削工人。

definition_en: to develop and use natural resources
example_en: The country plans to [exploit] its rich mineral resources.
example_zh: 该国计划开发其丰富的矿产资源。

definition_en: possible and practical to do
example_en: Is it [feasible] to finish the project in one month?
example_zh: 一个月完成这个项目可行吗？

definition_en: to change often between high and low levels
example_en: Vegetable prices [fluctuate] with the seasons.
example_zh: 蔬菜价格随季节波动。

definition_en: to make progress or action difficult
example_en: Heavy snow may [hinder] the rescue team's progress up the mountain.
example_zh: 大雪可能阻碍救援队上山的进度。

definition_en: extremely large or great
example_en: The project requires an [immense] amount of energy.
example_zh: 这个项目需要巨大的能量。

definition_en: too important to be without
example_en: A good dictionary is [indispensable] for language learners.
example_zh: 好词典对语言学习者不可或缺。

definition_en: one of the foods used to make a dish
example_en: Flour is the main [ingredient] of bread.
example_zh: 面粉是面包的主要原料。

definition_en: existing as a natural part of something
example_en: Every investment has some [inherent] risk.
example_zh: 每项投资都有一定的固有风险。

definition_en: allowed by law or reasonable and fair
example_en: The police found that the shop was a [legitimate] business, not a front for crime.
example_zh: 警方查明这家店是合法经营，而非犯罪的幌子。

definition_en: to make something look bigger or more important
example_en: A microscope can [magnify] cells thousands of times.
example_zh: 显微镜可以把细胞放大几千倍。

definition_en: to help two sides reach an agreement
example_en: A neutral country offered to [mediate] between the two sides.
example_zh: 一个中立国提出在双方之间斡旋。

definition_en: not proud of your achievements; not large
example_en: Despite winning the prize, he remained [modest] and thanked his team.
example_zh: 尽管获了奖，他仍然很谦虚，并感谢了他的团队。

definition_zh: 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的
definition_en: famous for something bad
example_en: The road is [notorious] for traffic accidents.
example_zh: 这条路因交通事故多而臭名昭著。

definition_en: hopeful about the future
example_en: Experts are [optimistic] that the new treatment will work.
example_zh: 专家们乐观地认为新疗法会奏效。

definition_en: to have too strong an effect on someone
example_en: Too much homework can [overwhelm] young students.
example_zh: 作业太多会压垮年幼的学生。

definition_en: important and well known
example_en: She is a [prominent] scientist whose work appears in every textbook.
example_zh: 她是一位著名科学家，她的成果出现在每本教科书里。

definition_en: not able to bend or change
example_en: Steel is strong but too [rigid] to bend by hand.
example_zh: 钢很结实，但太硬了，徒手掰不弯。

definition_en: to happen at the same time
example_en: The festival will [coincide] with the school holidays.
example_zh: 这个节日将与学校假期同时到来。

definition_en: to say or show the opposite of something
example_en: The new data [contradict] earlier findings.
example_zh: 新数据与早先的发现相矛盾。

definition_en: a standard used for judging something
example_en: Price is not the only [criterion] for choosing a school.
example_zh: 价格不是选择学校的唯一标准。

definition_en: to reach a conclusion from known facts
example_en: From the footprints, the police could [deduce] the thief's height.
example_zh: 警方能根据脚印推断出小偷的身高。

definition_en: to become worse
example_en: His health began to [deteriorate] last winter.
example_zh: 去年冬天他的健康开始恶化。

definition_en: a difference between things that should match
example_en: There is a [discrepancy] between the two sets of figures.
example_zh: 两组数据之间存在差异。

definition_en: more powerful or important than others
example_en: English is the [dominant] language of international science.
example_zh: 英语是国际科学界的主导语言。

definition_en: stated clearly and in detail
example_en: The sign is [explicit]: no phones are allowed in the exam room.
example_zh: 告示写得很明确：考场内禁止带手机。

definition_en: to make an action or process easier
example_en: The new software will [facilitate] communication between departments.
example_zh: 新软件将便利部门之间的沟通。

definition_en: a system with levels of importance
example_en: She quickly rose through the company [hierarchy].
example_zh: 她在公司的层级中迅速晋升。

definition_en: a set of political or economic beliefs
example_en: The party's [ideology] focuses on equality.
example_zh: 该党的思想体系强调平等。

definition_en: to suggest something without saying it directly
example_en: Her silence seemed to [imply] that she disagreed.
example_zh: 她的沉默似乎暗示她不同意。

definition_en: to combine parts or people into a whole
example_en: New students need time to [integrate] into school life.
example_zh: 新生需要时间融入校园生活。

definition_en: based on reason rather than feelings
example_en: We need a [rational] discussion, not an emotional argument.
example_zh: 我们需要理性的讨论，而不是情绪化的争吵。

definition_en: laws made by a government
example_en: New [legislation] protects people's privacy online.
example_zh: 新的法规保护人们的网络隐私。

definition_en: small and not important
example_en: There was only a [marginal] improvement in sales.
example_zh: 销售额只有微小的提升。

definition_en: something you plan to achieve
example_en: Our main [objective] is to reduce waste by half.
example_zh: 我们的主要目标是把浪费减半。

definition_en: not influenced by personal feelings
example_en: A judge must stay [objective] and not take either side.
example_zh: 法官必须保持客观，不偏袒任何一方。

definition_en: a statement that seems impossible but may be true
example_en: It is a [paradox] that more choice can make people less happy.
example_zh: 选择越多人反而越不快乐，这是个悖论。

definition_en: to notice or understand something
example_en: Dogs can [perceive] sounds that humans cannot hear.
example_zh: 狗能察觉到人类听不到的声音。

definition_en: something that happens and can be observed
example_en: Global warming is a worldwide [phenomenon].
example_zh: 全球变暖是一种全球性现象。

definition_en: seeming likely to be true
example_en: Her excuse sounded [plausible] at first, but nobody believed it later.
example_zh: 她的借口起初听起来似乎合理，但后来没人相信。

definition_en: the chance that something will happen
example_en: The [prospect] of finding a job after graduation worries many students.
example_zh: 毕业后找工作的前景让许多学生担忧。

definition_en: very new, different and extreme
example_en: His [radical] ideas shocked the older members of the board.
example_zh: 他的激进想法让董事会的老成员们震惊。

definition_en: to prove that a statement is wrong
example_en: The scientist used new data to [refute] the old theory.
example_zh: 这位科学家用新数据驳斥了旧理论。

definition_en: to make something stronger
example_en: Regular review can [reinforce] what you have learned.
example_zh: 定期复习能巩固所学内容。

definition_en: careful and thorough examination
example_en: The new policy is under close [scrutiny] from the public.
example_zh: 新政策正受到公众的严格审视。

definition_en: happening after something else
example_en: The book and its [subsequent] film were both successful.
example_zh: 这本书及随后改编的电影都很成功。

definition_en: not obvious or easy to notice
example_en: There is a [subtle] difference between the two colours.
example_zh: 两种颜色之间有细微的差别。

definition_en: to stop something by force or hold back a feeling
example_en: She tried to [suppress] a laugh during the meeting.
example_zh: 开会时她努力忍住不笑。

definition_en: not certain or fixed
example_en: Our meeting time is only [tentative] and may still change.
example_zh: 我们的会面时间只是暂定的，可能还会变。

definition_en: to change something completely
example_en: Online sales helped [transform] a small shop into a global brand.
example_zh: 网上销售帮助一家小店转变为全球品牌。

definition_en: to experience a process or change
example_en: Patients must [undergo] a health check before surgery.
example_zh: 病人手术前必须接受健康检查。

definition_en: to use something in an effective way
example_en: Students should [utilize] the library's online resources.
example_zh: 学生应充分利用图书馆的网络资源。

definition_en: to check that something is true
example_en: Please [verify] your email address before logging in.
example_zh: 登录前请验证你的电子邮箱地址。

definition_en: the quality of being logical, true or legal
example_en: Some experts question the [validity] of the survey.
example_zh: 一些专家质疑这项调查的有效性。

definition_en: general agreement among a group
example_en: There is a broad [consensus] that smoking is harmful.
example_zh: 人们普遍认同吸烟有害。

definition_en: increasing by being added to over time
example_en: The [cumulative] effect of small savings can be large.
example_zh: 小额储蓄的累积效应可能很大。

definition_en: something needed before something else can happen
example_en: A good command of English is a [prerequisite] for this course.
example_zh: 良好的英语水平是学习这门课程的先决条件。

definition_en: to keep or continue to have something
example_en: The town has managed to [retain] its traditional character.
example_zh: 这座小镇设法保留了传统特色。

definition_en: to encourage something to grow or develop
example_en: Lower taxes may [stimulate] the economy.
example_zh: 减税可能刺激经济。

definition_zh: 负担得起的；价格合理的
definition_en: cheap enough for people to buy
example_en: Young workers need homes that are [affordable] on a small salary.
example_zh: 年轻上班族需要靠微薄工资也负担得起的住房。

definition_en: the science and work of farming
example_en: Most people in the region work in [agriculture].
example_zh: 该地区大多数人从事农业。

definition_en: the variety of plants and animals in an area
example_en: Rainforests have extremely high [biodiversity].
example_zh: 热带雨林的生物多样性极高。

definition_en: a plan of how much money can be spent
example_en: We have a limited [budget] for the trip.
example_zh: 我们这次旅行的预算有限。

definition_en: cheap and offering few extra services
example_en: Many students travel on [budget] airlines.
example_zh: 许多学生乘坐廉价航空出行。

definition_en: a chemical element found in all living things
example_en: Trees absorb [carbon] from the atmosphere.
example_zh: 树木从大气中吸收碳。

definition_en: too many vehicles or people in one place
example_en: Traffic [congestion] is a daily problem in big cities.
example_zh: 交通拥堵是大城市每天都面临的问题。

definition_en: the protection of nature or careful use of resources
example_en: Wildlife [conservation] helps protect endangered species from extinction.
example_zh: 野生动物保护有助于使濒危物种免于灭绝。

definition_en: a particular style of cooking
example_en: Sichuan [cuisine] is famous for its spicy flavours.
example_zh: 川菜以麻辣著称。

definition_en: a building where students live
example_en: First-year students usually live in a [dormitory] on campus.
example_zh: 一年级学生通常住在校内宿舍。

definition_en: gas or other substance sent into the air
example_en: The factory must cut its [emission] of harmful gases.
example_zh: 工厂必须减少有害气体的排放。

definition_en: to officially join a course or school
example_en: You can [enrol] in the course online.
example_zh: 你可以在网上报名参加这门课程。

definition_en: no longer existing
example_en: Dinosaurs became [extinct] millions of years ago.
example_zh: 恐龙在数百万年前就灭绝了。

definition_en: able to produce good crops or young
example_en: Crops grow well in the river valley because the soil is [fertile].
example_zh: 河谷土壤肥沃，庄稼长得很好。

definition_en: the remains of an ancient animal or plant in rock
example_en: Scientists found a dinosaur [fossil] in the desert.
example_zh: 科学家在沙漠中发现了一块恐龙化石。

definition_en: the process of the world's economies becoming connected
example_en: Many people believe that [globalisation] benefits developing countries.
example_zh: 许多人认为全球化有利于发展中国家。

definition_en: containing a lot of water in the air
example_en: The weather in Guangzhou is hot and [humid] in summer.
example_zh: 广州夏天天气又热又潮湿。

definition_en: basic systems such as roads, water and power
example_en: The government plans to invest in rural [infrastructure] such as roads and power lines.
example_zh: 政府计划投资道路、电网等农村基础设施。

definition_en: supplying water to land or crops
example_en: Modern [irrigation] saves a great deal of water.
example_zh: 现代灌溉技术节约了大量用水。

definition_en: free time for rest and enjoyment
example_en: People today have less [leisure] than they expected.
example_zh: 如今人们的闲暇时间比预想的少。

definition_en: a talk given to students or an audience
example_en: The professor gave a [lecture] on modern art.
example_zh: 教授做了一场关于现代艺术的讲座。

definition_en: to criticise someone in a long serious talk
example_en: My parents often [lecture] me about staying up late.
example_zh: 我父母经常为熬夜的事训我。

definition_en: to move from one place to another
example_en: Many birds [migrate] south for the winter.
example_zh: 许多鸟冬天向南迁徙。

definition_en: the food needed for health and growth
example_en: Good [nutrition] is essential for children's growth.
example_zh: 良好的营养对儿童成长至关重要。

definition_en: the condition of being very overweight
example_en: Childhood [obesity] is rising in many countries.
example_zh: 许多国家的儿童肥胖率在上升。

definition_en: a person walking in the street
example_en: The car stopped to let a [pedestrian] cross the road.
example_zh: 汽车停下让一名行人过马路。

definition_en: a list of questions used in a survey
example_en: Please fill in the [questionnaire] after the class.
example_zh: 下课后请填写这份问卷。

definition_en: money returned to a customer
example_en: If the shoes do not fit, you can ask for a [refund].
example_zh: 如果鞋子不合脚，你可以要求退款。

definition_en: able to be replaced naturally
example_en: Wind and solar power are [renewable] energy sources.
example_zh: 风能和太阳能是可再生能源。

definition_en: used for homes rather than offices or factories
example_en: The factory is too close to a [residential] area.
example_zh: 工厂离住宅区太近了。

definition_en: money given to a student to help pay for study
example_en: She won a [scholarship] to study in Australia.
example_zh: 她获得了赴澳大利亚留学的奖学金。

definition_en: one of the two periods of a school year
example_en: The new [semester] starts in September.
example_zh: 新学期九月开始。

definition_en: something you buy to remember a place or trip
example_en: I bought a small [souvenir] for my sister in Paris.
example_zh: 我在巴黎给妹妹买了一件小纪念品。

definition_en: an area of homes outside the centre of a city
example_en: They moved to a quiet [suburb] of Shanghai.
example_zh: 他们搬到了上海一个安静的郊区。

definition_en: the business of providing services for tourists
example_en: The island depends heavily on [tourism].
example_zh: 这座岛严重依赖旅游业。

definition_en: relating to a city or town
example_en: More than half the population now lives in [urban] areas.
example_zh: 现在一半以上的人口住在城市地区。

definition_en: a substance that protects people against a disease
example_en: Scientists developed a new [vaccine] against the flu.
example_zh: 科学家研制出一种新的流感疫苗。

definition_en: a person who does not eat meat
example_en: My sister became a [vegetarian] last year.
example_zh: 我姐姐去年成了素食者。

definition_en: all the people who work in a company or country
example_en: Women make up half of the [workforce].
example_zh: 女性占劳动力的一半。

definition_en: animals living in natural conditions
example_en: The national park is home to rare [wildlife] such as snow leopards.
example_zh: 国家公园里栖息着雪豹等珍稀野生动物。

definition_en: a long period without rain
example_en: The [drought] destroyed most of the crops.
example_zh: 干旱毁掉了大部分庄稼。

definition_en: a machine used in the home
example_en: A washing machine is the most useful [appliance] in our home.
